description: Fetch the parent/child continuity (priority) chain for one patent application — every earlier application this one claims priority from (continuation, divisional, CIP, provisional, etc.) and every later application that in turn claims priority from it, each with the claim type, dates, and the parent/child's own patent number where granted. Use this to answer "what did this patent come from" or "what later patents/applications descend from this one". An application with no continuity relationships returns an empty chain on both sides — that is a real, common answer (most applications are standalone filings), not a failure.

_apiKey.description: USPTO ODP API key. Get free at https://data.uspto.gov/myodp.

number.description: US application number, digits only or formatted. Examples: "17248024", "16/123,456".

name: get_patent_continuity
title: Get Patent Continuity
